prohibition: The outcome must never be derived from the predictor. No rule of the form s3_diag < threshold => resistant is permitted as a label. No such rule exists in any repository.

source_study.citation: Smith P, Bradley T, Gavarro LM, et al. Nat Commun 14, 4387 (2023)

primary.diagnosis_to_registration_interval_avail: yes, as the negative time value for event=='diag' in figure_1B_layer_1.tsv

primary_resistant.caveat: Pools refractory with resistant; the two cannot be separated in open data.

primary_refractory.consequence: Refractory patients are pooled inside primary_resistant, making that class heterogeneous in severity.

censored_before_assessable.available_instead: overall survival time and vital status only (event=='os', status in {alive, deceased})

indeterminate_missing.note: figure_1B_layer_1.tsv labels all 273 patients, so strict_n_missing_label = 0. Genuine adjudication indeterminacy cannot be distinguished from a confident label because the adjudication inputs are not released.

pfi_reconstruction.proof: figure_1B_layer_1.tsv has exactly five columns (britroc_number, pt_sensitivity_at_reg, status, event, time); event takes exactly two values, 'diag' (273 rows) and 'os' (273 rows). No progression event, no PFS, no PFI, no treatment date exists in any released file. figure_2.tsv adds day_diff and num_lines, neither of which is a platinum-free interval.

binding_rule: Primary denominator is n=98 / 20 events. Any figure quoted at n=67 / 9 events, including the 0.8807 CV receipt and every adjusted model, must carry the set98->set67 selection warning.

ALT_A_rclass.standing_warning: On the identical 40-patient s7_rel feature matrix, AUROC = 0.8739 under rclass and 0.3136 under pt_sensitivity_at_reg. Any rclass result must be reported alongside the same analysis under the primary endpoint.

ALT_B_pfi_6mo.reserved_for: controlled-access analysis once date fields are available

ALT_C_os_surrogate.availability: available; 39 events in the n=67 set

major_bump_triggers: any change to the primary endpoint definition
any change to the denominator ladder
minor_bump_triggers: adding a five-class member as data becomes available
change_control.enforcement: The adversarial suite asserts that the endpoint contract version recorded in candidate_spec_v0.1.0.json matches the contract used at scoring time; a mismatch must refuse.
